environment.description: Same Node.js 18 Apollo Server on ECS Fargate behind ALB. PostgreSQL 14 on RDS with connection via IAM database authentication. The database role 'app_readonly_7f3a' was provisioned through a Terraform module that applies pg_hba.conf entry restricting the role. The role grant was issued as: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_readonly_7f3a; with no additional privileges. A separate pg_hba.conf line enforces 'hostssl all app_readonly_7f3a 10.0.0.0/16 md5' ensuring only this role connects from the VPC CIDR. The RDS parameter group has 'log_statement=all' and 'pgaudit.log=write' enabled. Note: the application code still attempts UPDATE/INSERT operations through mutations, but these will receive permission denied errors at the database layer. No explicit GRANT for INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE exists for this role, and the role has NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE attributes. The default_transaction_read_only parameter is NOT set (transactions are read-write capable at session level), so the protection relies solely on the object-level GRANT restrictions.

config.db_permissions: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_readonly_7f3a
